{{Quote|Three scrumptious, thick slices	of egg-dipped Iktotchian gravelwheat bread cooked golden brown and dusted with powdered Christophsian sugar. Served piping hot with bantha butter and carbosyrup|Dex's Diner menu listing for Iktotch toast|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Iktotchian gravelwheat bread''' was could be used to make [[Iktotch toast]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> The [[Bread/Legends|bread]] shared its name with the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|from]] the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Iktotch/Legends|Iktotch]] which was located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Nexus of Power">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] sold three slices of Iktotch [[Toast/Legends|toast]] for 4.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The diner prepared its toast by dipping the bread in [[Egg/Legends|egg]], then cooking it on the diner's [[robo-griddle]] and dusting it powdered [[Christophsian sugar/Legends|Christophsian sugar]]. It was served hot with [[bantha butter]] and [[carbosyrup]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Iktotchian gravelwheat bread was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
